Class VirtualClient

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.network.VirtualClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
EndGameObserver, GameObserver, HomeObserver
Direct Known Subclasses:
RMIClientHandler, SocketClientHandler
public abstract class VirtualClient extends Object implements GameObserver, HomeObserver, EndGameObserver
Transport-agnostic representation of a connected client on the server side.

Implements GameObserver, HomeObserver, and EndGameObserver to receive push notifications from the model and convert them into ServerResponse objects that are forwarded to the actual network layer via sendResponse(ServerResponse).

Concrete subclasses (SocketClientHandler, RMIClientHandler) implement sendResponse(ServerResponse) and closeConnection() for their respective transport.

The lastPing timestamp is volatile and updated on every ping to allow the timeout checker in ServerController to detect stale connections.
